as_told.title: Gray alien figure in the Dugway Proving Grounds cafeteria

plain: There is said to be a picture of an alien in the cafeteria of the West Desert Test Center, part of Dugway Proving Ground, a large Army testing range in the Utah desert. An online researcher known as UAPGerb shows it on the show, crediting it to a man named Ryan W. Harris, and says: "this is in the cafeteria at the West Desert Test Center." Michels mentions it himself on a later episode as "a little gray alien being" in the cafeteria at Dugway Proving Grounds. They bring it up as a hint that the people who work at the base know more about aliens than the public does.
